The eight rows of the table above are deployment and platform items. Their BR Field IDs are Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P8-E2027-OPS-7). `decision_record` is a PLT library table created in `rwb_payment`, one of the library objects of the Schema row.

The PAYMENT_MATCH rows live only in the rule package, and no service schema holds a match rule table. The package tries its rows in the order EXACT, then PARTIAL, then WINDOW, and its scenario set tests that one order. This story holds version PM-2026.12, in force from 2026-12-01. RWB-E2-042 records PMT-2026.12, valid from 2026-12-15, for the same package. The rule owner RW-COE, with the P7 and P3 solution architects, reconciles the two into one label and one valid-from date before the package is promoted in SIT, so that the registry holds one row per package version.
